traits.note: Abrams's flora (vol. 1, 1923; ferns by Maxon), under Struthiopteris, the name it then used for the deer fern's genus: fronds of two kinds, the fertile ones few and long-stalked with narrow segments bearing sporangia over their whole underside; each sorus a line parallel to the midrib just inside the margin, under an indusium fixed inside the margin and facing the midrib. Stated at the genus as the flora gives it; Blechnum as WCVP v16 takes it is wider, and its other species say otherwise in their own files.
